Forme juridique de l'attributaire Le marché public sera conclu : – soit avec un opérateur économique unique ; 8/17 – soit avec un groupement d’opérateurs économiques conjoint ou solidaire. En cas de groupement conjoint, le mandataire sera solidaire, pour l'exécution du marché public, de chacun des membres du groupement, pour ses obligations contractuelles à l'égard de l’acheteur. La composition du groupement ne peut être modifiée entre la remise des offres et la date de signature du contrat. 2-6. ant indiquant qu'il ne tombe pas sous le coup d'une interdiction de soumissionner. Pour satisfaire aux obligations susmentionnées, le candidat qui envisage, dès le dépôt de son offre, de sous-traiter une partie de sa prestation, complètera utilement la déclaration de sous - traitance et joindra, pour chaque sous-traitant, l’ensemble des documents, attestations et renseignements réclamés aux candidats, tels que figurant au présent règlement de la consultation. La notification du marché public emporte acceptation du sous-traitant et agrément des conditions de paiement. Les prestations de services sont prouvées par des attestations du destinataire ou, à défaut, par une déclaration de l'opérateur économique ; • Une déclaration indiquant les effectifs moyens annuels du candidat et l'importance du personnel d'encadrement pendant les trois dernières années ; • Une description de l'outillage, du matériel et de l'équipement technique dont le candidat disposera pour la réalisation du marché public. Käsikirjadega saab tutvuda Google Drive kaustast Täpsem ajakava lepitakse eduka pakkujaga ühe kuu jooksul alates lepingu sõlmimisest. Pakkuja ja tellija lepivad kokku kooskõlastusringide tähtaegadest, vastutajatest ja kontaktisikutest. Ajakava koostamisel lähtutakse alljärgnevatest punktidest 5.3-5.11. Pakkuja töö hõlmab vähemalt järgmisi kooskõlastatud tööetappe: käsikirjade terviklik ülevaatus ja toimetamisvajaduse kaardistamine; ühe kooliastme klasside terminoloogia, struktuuri ja vormistuslahenduste ühtlustamine; kujunduskontseptsiooni ja näidiskülgede koostamine ning kooskõlastamine tellija ja autoritega; illustratsioonide, fotode, ikoonide ja muude visuaalsete elementide loomine või hankimine; esmane küljendus; katsetamise ja retsenseerimise tagasiside alusel muudatuste tegemine; lõplik keeleline ja tehniline korrektuur; trükifailide ettevalmistamine ja tellijapoolne kinnitamine enne trükki. Osades 1–3 kirjeldatud lõplike materjalide trükkimise eel viiakse läbi õppekomplektide katsetamine, milleks on vaja ette valmistada ja trükkida katsetuseksemplarid ja saata need katsetajatele. Purpose This Quality Assurance Surveillance Plan (QASP) is a Government developed and applied document used to ensure the systematic Quality Assurance (QA) methods are used in the administration surveillance of tasking under the Contract. The intent is to ensure the Contractor performs In Accordance With (IAW) the Performance Work Statement (PWS) and the Government receives the quality of services called for in the FFP contract. The Contractor shall deliver fully operational, integrated, and sustained EW SITE systems and sub-system components for domestic and Foreign Military Sales (FMS) customers. The required outcome is an EW SITE system capable of supporting a multitude of laboratory-specific System Configurations across multiple platforms (EA-18G, F/A-18, MH-60) while maintaining configuration consistency with the Advanced Weapons Laboratory (AWL) at NAWCWD China Lake, CA. Additionally, the Contractor shall ensure continuous operational readiness of current EW SITE systems through comprehensive lifecycle support, including on-call and on-site maintenance, system upgrades, replacement parts provisioning, and personnel training. This Contract will have FFP CLINs. The Contract will have a five-year period of performance. A properly executed QASP will assist the Government in achieving the objectives of this procurement. 2. Commissioning: Commissioning is a process that involves the entire Design Team throughout the planning, design, construction and occupancy of the project. Commissioning Guidelines for AOC Projects are contained in the policy statement of June 7, 2010. During the initial planning process, the AOC Project Team shall determine the purpose and role of commissioning. The purpose may be to ensure proper integration of a small renovation/rehabilitation into the Capitol 7 AOC Order 28-8, December 26, 2018 complex, or it may be related to a certification. It may range from simple, direct Owner commissioning by the AOC to an independent Commissioning Agent with a substantial budget. As a rule, if a project is designed by an Associate A/E, then commissioning will be performed by a third party hired by the AOC. LE: files/Attach_1_-_Blood_Transfusion_Services_SOW.pdf ===== Statement of Work For Transfusion Services 20 October 2026 I. Background: The 88th Medical Group Transfusion Services requires blood components and references lab transfusion testing services. The supplier shall provide blood products and reference blood transfusion services (testing) to support the blood supply in case of emergency situations and inpatient and outpatient care at the WPAFB Medical Center when requested for a period of 5 years at the prices in the approved price list. II. Minimum Technical Requirements: The supplier shall provide blood products and reference transfusion testing that are time dependent with immediate response and expedience to treat critical patients. The supplier must operate 24/7 as the 88th Medical Group (MDG) is a 24/7 operation; this service must be available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including holidays and weekends. The supplier shall provide rapid shipment of blood products when the 88 MDG Transfusion Services in-house inventory is in need to support critical patients. The one-hour turnaround time for testing is a mission-critical requirement. The blood supplier shall deliver routine blood products ordered on a STAT basis within one (1) hour of the blood sup

eipt of an emergent request for blood products. The required completion point is delivery to the Transfusion Services department. The supplier must fulfill our request with the ordered product with appropriate compatible blood type, applicable testing, and requested quantities. Any unforeseen delays are understandable; however, the ultimate goal is for the delivering agency to aim for the <1 hour delivery time. An appropriate transmittal list is required with each delivery. If emergent requests are unable to be consistently met, it could mean critical failure for our hospital's life-saving capabilities. The supplier shall have 24/7 reference laboratory testing capabilities for patients anticipating transfusions or medical treatment. The supplier must be licensed by the Food & Drug Administration (FDA) and follow American Association of Blood Bank (AABB) standards. The supplier must notify the 88th MDG Transfusion Services of all unexpected/abnormal tests from blood products supplied by them. The supplier shall provide look-back notifications to the 88th MDG as required by 21 CFR 610.48 (b)(3): (a) within three (3) calendar days if blood collected from a donor who tested negative at the time of donation but tests reactive for evidence of HIV or HCV infection on a later do
